packageRules.description: pnpm itself is updated through packageManager / .tool-versions, not as a devDependency, so the dev-deps group never caught it: it got its own PR, no schedule, re-run on every rebase (32 factory CI runs in a day, 2026-10-07). Minor/patch ride the Monday group; majors still arrive alone.
pnpm 11.12.0 self-installer regression breaks pnpm/action-setup in CI (integrity/undefined crash). Skip only that version; other pnpm updates allowed.

Block TypeScript major bumps. TS7 ships the native (Go) compiler, whose JS API shim lacks getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile — @nestjs/cli's `nest start`/`nest build` crash on it. Matches the typescript override pinned in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Re-enable deliberately once the toolchain supports TS7.

Every @nestjs/* package must move together. The v12 line is ESM-only ("type": "module", a single ./index.js, no require condition), so a nest-monorepo major that lands without its siblings is red no matter what — @nestjs/jwt@12 peer-depends on @nestjs/common@12, and factory closed three such split PRs as superseded before grouping them. Mirrors the rule in factory and competition-factory-server.
